evidence.explanation: Content lists (i) Escribed circles and (ii) Drawing of circles to touch some given points. Example 1 gives the method to escribe a circle on a given triangle (extend two sides, bisect the two exterior angles, drop a perpendicular to a side, centre O); Example 2 gives the method for a polygon (join opposite corners, bisect external angles, perpendicular to a side, repeat per side). The evaluation questions ask for a circle escribed on a 55-60-50 mm triangle and circles described about a 50 mm hexagon.
